assertions.assertion: Uses IApiScopeAdmin.CreateAsync with ApiScopeConfiguration before creating the resource/client that references it
assertions.rationale: Calls scopeAdmin.CreateAsync(new ApiScopeConfiguration{...}) first, before resource and client.

assertions.assertion: Uses IApiResourceAdmin and IClientAdmin.CreateAsync with CreateClient and CreateClientSecret { PlaintextValue = ... }
assertions.rationale: Uses IApiResourceAdmin and clientAdmin.CreateAsync(new CreateClient{... ClientSecrets=[new CreateClientSecret{PlaintextValue=...}]}).
Checks result.IsSuccess after each create and got.Found after GetAsync.

assertions.assertion: Updates via GetAsync then UpdateAsync(id, item, current.Version, ct) to get optimistic concurrency
assertions.rationale: GetAsync then UpdateAsync(id, item, got.Version, ct) with conflict handling.

assertions.assertion: Warns to protect/authorize the admin APIs (they are .NET service APIs, not preconfigured HTTP endpoints) and to load secrets from a secure source
assertions.rationale: Says admin services are .NET APIs not HTTP endpoints to be put behind authN/authZ, and secret taken from vault.
